title: Moss the Stegosaurus and the Fern Hollow
description: A moss-green stegosaurus walks his herd to a warm fern hollow, and a smaller friend settles under his leaf-gold plate for the night.

Moss.color: Moss-green body with one leaf-gold plate on his back and the other plates a deeper moss green
Moss.bodyShape: Young stegosaurus, low and gentle, with a tail and plates, and no human arms or hands
Moss.face: Round gentle eyes and a small calm smile
Moss.accessories: No clothes or tools; the single leaf-gold plate is his mark

Poppy.role: Supporting character; a smaller stegosaurus friend
Poppy.color: Softer sage green all over, with smaller sage plates and no gold plate
Poppy.bodyShape: Smaller and shorter than Moss, with no human arms or hands
Poppy.face: Round gentle eyes, a little younger than Moss

settingBible.Fern Hollow: A gold evening dinosaur valley, a quiet stream, untouched nests, and a warm fern hollow under the stars
settingBible.herd: A few larger moss-green stegosauruses walking wide and careful; they have no gold plates
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded dinosaurs, one scene per page, gold evening into starry night, and no readable text

continuityRules: Moss stays moss-green with exactly one leaf-gold plate, round gentle eyes, and no human hands.
Poppy stays smaller, sage green, with sage plates and no gold plate.
The herd is larger, moss-green, and has no gold plates, so Moss and Poppy stay recognizable.
They walk to sleep together; there is no search, rescue, or repair.
Light moves from gold evening to starry night in the same valley.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or watermark.

pages.text: Once the valley turned gold, the day grew quiet and warm.
pages.illustrationScene: Moss stands in a dinosaur valley turned gold at the end of the day, quiet and warm.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Moss's moss-green body, one leaf-gold plate, and round gentle eyes.

pages.text: Moss walked at the back so no one was left behind, but he stayed calm.
pages.illustrationScene: Moss walks calmly at the back of a small stegosaurus herd on the gold valley path.
pages.continuityNotes: He is last on purpose, not because anyone is lost. Herd has no gold plates.

pages.text: Poppy, a smaller stegosaurus, matched him step for step.
pages.illustrationScene: Small sage-green Poppy walks beside Moss, matching his slow steps at the back of the herd.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Poppy as smaller, sage, with no gold plate.

pages.text: They passed a quiet stream and took one slow sip.
pages.illustrationScene: Moss and Poppy take one slow sip from a quiet stream while the herd waits gently.

pages.text: The herd chose the path that did not shake the nests.
pages.illustrationScene: The herd, with Moss and Poppy at the back, follows a soft path away from small still nests.
pages.continuityNotes: Nests stay still and untouched. No one disturbs them.

pages.text: Stars came out, one, then three, then many.
pages.illustrationScene: Stars appear over the valley, first one, then three, then many, above Moss and Poppy.

pages.text: Moss found a hollow of ferns still warm from the sun.
pages.illustrationScene: Moss looks into a fern hollow that still looks warm from the sun, with Poppy beside him.
pages.continuityNotes: Fern hollow is the bedtime place. Nothing is broken.

pages.text: The herd turned in, wide and careful.
pages.illustrationScene: The larger herd settles wide and careful around the fern hollow while Moss and Poppy wait.
pages.continuityNotes: Herd settles without crowding the small pair.

pages.text: Poppy was not sure where to lie, so Moss lowered his leaf-gold plate like a tent.
pages.illustrationScene: Moss lowers his one leaf-gold plate like a small tent while Poppy stands close, deciding.
pages.continuityNotes: Only the leaf-gold plate makes the tent. Poppy is unsure, not hurt.

pages.illustrationScene: Poppy tucks under Moss's leaf-gold plate in the fern hollow.
pages.continuityNotes: Poppy fits underneath because she is smaller. Plate color unchanged.

pages.text: A night bird called once, and the herd stayed still.
pages.illustrationScene: The settled herd stays still in the ferns as one night bird calls, with Poppy under Moss's plate.
pages.continuityNotes: One call. Everyone stays still and calm.

pages.text: Moss watched the stars between the fern tips.
pages.illustrationScene: Moss looks up at stars showing between fern tips while Poppy rests under his plate.
pages.continuityNotes: Same stars and ferns. Poppy remains tucked.

pages.text: The valley wind was only a sigh.
pages.illustrationScene: A very soft wind moves the fern tips like a sigh around the resting herd, Moss, and Poppy.
pages.continuityNotes: Wind is only a sigh, not a storm.

pages.text: Poppy's eyes closed, and Moss stayed until her breaths were even.
pages.illustrationScene: Poppy sleeps with closed eyes under the leaf-gold plate while Moss stays awake and still.
pages.continuityNotes: Moss stays by choice until Poppy's breathing is even.

pages.text: Moss rested his chin on the ferns, so goodnight, valley, and goodnight, herd.
pages.illustrationScene: Moss rests his chin on the ferns beside sleeping Poppy, with the herd quiet under the stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Goodnight ending. Moss still has one leaf-gold plate. Poppy stays sage and smaller.
